acceptanceCriteria: The three-language map cites the current latest-main entry points and call chains for CLI/MCP, observation and snapshots, Contract/policy/evidence validation, governance decisions, lifecycle transitions, execution/scheduling, status/Outcome/human-decision projection, and persistence/recovery.

The map identifies authoritative fact sources, permitted file/Git/process/record I/O, validation/decision/display ownership, concrete duplicate observation or mixed responsibility, dependency direction, and reusable mechanisms with current file:line citations.
For P1-B, P2-A, P2-B, P2-C, and P3, the map records a concrete problem, target boundary, compatibility risk, and verification method without prescribing a broad interface design.
The three language pages and parity projections are consistent and preserve the documentation-only boundary.
goal: Document the latest main responsibility boundaries, authoritative fact sources, allowed I/O, dependency direction, reusable mechanisms, and bounded candidate refactors without changing runtime behavior.
intent: Establish a current, cited responsibility and dependency map for the AI Cockpit architecture before further P1-B, P2, and P3 changes.
outOfScope: Runtime implementation and generated governance records
